ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Body text, headings, button fill, icon strokes — near-black rather than true black keeps contrast high without harshness

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Page background, button text on dark fills, nav surface

mist.$description: Mist — Secondary button background, alternating section background fill

cloud.$description: Cloud — Card borders, dividers, section background tint

stone.$description: Stone — Subtle component borders, input strokes

graphite.$description: Graphite — Nav text, secondary UI labels, ghost button labels

slate.$description: Slate — Body text secondary, border colors in nav and footer contexts

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Body copy at normal reading weight

iron.$description: Iron — List items, link text in content areas

ash.$description: Ash — Placeholder text, disabled state indicators

asana-violet.$description: Asana Violet — Hero product UI, informational badges, branded accent blocks — deep indigo-navy grounds AI and premium feature messaging

coral-blush.$description: Coral Blush — Active filter chip background, soft badge backgrounds, warm section fills — coral warmth signals interaction state without aggression

deep-coral.$description: Deep Coral — Coral-family high-contrast text on Coral Blush backgrounds, brand icon accents

coral-ember.$description: Coral Ember — Icon fills in use-case cards, logo mark accent — vivid red-coral appears only in small illustration contexts

coral-dark.$description: Coral Dark — Hover/pressed state for coral-family brand elements

sky-ice.$description: Sky Ice — Blue-tinted soft background for feature callouts and informational chips

coral-petal.$description: Coral Petal — Icon strokes, subtle link decoration, light illustrative borders in coral family

ghost.$description: Display headlines only — the hero statement and major section titles. Weight 500 at 60-72px with tight -0.007em tracking compresses letter forms into dense editorial blocks. No other font on the site operates at this scale, making Ghost the unambiguous voice of authority.

twk-lausanne.$description: Everything except hero display text: nav labels (weight 400, 14px), body copy (weight 300–400, 16px), subheadings (weight 500, 20-30px), section headings (weight 500, 24-36px). Weight 300 for body imparts an open, non-urgent reading texture. Weight 500 for UI labels and mid-hierarchy headings. Positive letter-spacing at small sizes (+0.025–0.04em) prevents optical crowding in captions and badges.
